subject: MedFora Kickoff: roll-call, agenda & tech check
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: MedFora kickoff — proposed roll-call & tech check

Team —

We have the MedFora kickoff scheduled for Mon, Nov 30 in their calendar block (see calendar link below). Before we lock final invites I need two things from you:

1) Confirm attendees from our side (who will speak to integrations, security, and pricing). Prefer concise: name + role + 1-line owner for that segment.
2) Availability for a 30-minute technical check with MedFora IT 30 minutes before the kickoff (they requested a dedicated window to validate network/egress rules).

Proposed times (MedFora prefers PST):
- Tech check: 11:00–11:30 PST (kickoff at 11:30)
- Kickoff: 11:30–12:30 PST

Suggested internal roster (fill or change):
- Karthik Iyer — CSM handoff + rollout plan (owner: kickoff overview)
- Marissa Cole — Solutions Engineer (owner: integration boundaries)
- Monica Patel — Customer Success (owner: adoption and milestones)
- Laura Bennett — Implementation PM (owner: timelines & tasks)

I'll draft the customer-facing agenda once you confirm. Also planning to attach the latest SOW and agenda draft to the invite — let me know if anyone needs redlines before invites go out.

Calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcdef123456
Drive folder (shared assets): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1MedForaOnboarding

Thanks — please reply inline.

--
Karthik
Product Specialist, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MedFora kickoff — proposed roll-call & tech check

+1 on the roster — sounds good. Quick notes:
- I'll lead the integration portion and bring the network checklist (will attach).
- Laura, happy to handoff timelines to you during the PM section.
- Recommend we include a 5-minute intro to caching/kv expectations for their infra team.

I've uploaded the draft agenda and infrastructure checklist to the Drive. Attaching the agenda to this thread for quick review.

Attachments: Kickoff-Agenda-v2.docx (attached), infrastructure-checklist.xlsx (attached)

Marissa
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Cc: Tom Ramirez <tom.ramirez@medfora.com>, MedFora IT <it@medfora.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MedFora kickoff — proposed roll-call & tech check

Hi Karthik / team —

Thanks for putting this together. Confirming MedFora attendees from our side:
- Lily Chen — Head of Data & ML (will lead kickoff)
- Tom Ramirez — Director, Integrations (technical lead)
- Priya Anand — Platform Eng (will join the tech check)
- Andrew Lowe — Security (may be on the line for the architecture portion)

Small ask: can we move the kickoff 30 minutes later to 12:00–13:00 PST and run the tech check at 11:15–11:45 PST? That gives our folks time between other calls. If that works for you, please update the calendar invite and share the Zoom link.

Also, Tom (cc'd) would like a short breakout after the kickoff to confirm API keys and S3 access patterns — can we reserve ~15 minutes?

Looking forward — attach any pre-reads we should review me.

Best,
Lily
Head of Data & ML, MedFora Health
lily.chen@medfora.com

Lily — thanks, that timing works for us. Updated details below and I updated the calendar event.

Final schedule (PST):
- Tech check (IT validation): 11:15–11:45 — Zoom (meeting opens at 11:10)
- Kickoff: 12:00–13:00 — Zoom main session
- Post-kickoff integrations breakout (optional): 13:00–13:15

Zoom link (primary): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=kickoff
Calendar (updated): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcdef123456
Drive (materials): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1MedForaOnboarding

Attachments included on the invite: MedFora-SOW-v1.pdf, Kickoff-Agenda-v2.docx, infrastructure-checklist.xlsx

Notes / owner callouts:
- Karthik Iyer: kickoff overview, success milestones, rollouts
- Marissa Cole: integration surface + network checklist (lead during tech check)
- Monica Patel: adoption plan + customer success cadence
- Laura Bennett: project plan and next steps (I'll assign initial owners during the call)

Lily — per Tom's ask, we will hold the 15-min integrations breakout immediately after the main session to confirm API keys and S3 permissions. Please have your platform engineer (Priya) on that breakout.
